title: Giant Glow Paddleboarding the Downtown Skyline with Bats
includes: We provide the Giant Paddleboards, paddles, life jackets, and a dry empty cooler that you can use as a storage and captions seat. Of course, we also provide the glow lights.
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This specific tour is really similar to the kayaking with the bats or giant Paddleboarding with the bats only its more of a VIP experience. 

You start after most people, stay out longer than most, and you get more photos of your group and you're after dark photos should be amazing. 

You are welcome to start early with the other tours to catch more of the sunset and still stay out late to play with the glow lights. Sometimes if the Glow bookings are small, we'll ask you to start early.
